title: The Stacks
pages:
Shelves without a library. Books written in a hand I almost know.

The archive does not keep what happened. It keeps what he was afraid to forget, which is a smaller and much stranger thing.

I turned a page and it was a map of the stronghold. I turned it back and it was a shopping list.

He always did write everything down. Then lose the lists.

The Endermen do not look at me anymore.

I think they have decided I am furniture. I find that restful.
